gloss: tea cakes; snacks served with tea

definitions.gloss: tea cakes; tea sweets; snacks served with tea
definitions.explanation: Sweets or light snacks that are served alongside tea, especially during the tea ceremony or when entertaining guests. Typically Japanese confections but can include Western-style sweets.

examples.english: I served tea snacks to the guests.

examples.english: Choosing tea sweets that complement the bitterness of matcha is one of the pleasures of the tea ceremony.

notes:
USAGE:
In formal tea ceremony (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧), the choice of {茶菓子|ちゃがし} is important and often reflects the season. In everyday use, it refers to any sweet or snack served with tea when hosting visitors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶菓子|ちゃがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to serve tea snacks)
- {茶菓子|ちゃがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧ (to prepare tea snacks)
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茶菓子|ちゃがし} (seasonal tea sweets)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧: Japanese confections — broader category that includes all traditional Japanese sweets, not just those served with tea
